observation_contract.comparison_scope: Equality of the declared diagnostic observation. A returned Function view hides captures and is not extensional closure equality; C09/C10 exercise captures by calling functions to ground data results.
observation_contract.oracle: Independent pending derivation goals with value slots and immutable lexical mappings; no engine/OBS/CALL import or lowering.
observation_contract.manual_grounding: Every finite matrix execution is additionally compared to an authored full trace/outcome cut at the declared budget and cancellation boundary.
observation_contract.physical_guard_exception: The semantic oracle has no implementation allocation limits. B07 compares the whole pre-refusal trace; it explicitly does not claim equality of terminal categories.
